deterministic_rules.pass: at least two lifestyle runs reach min_stage and at least three unique primary families exist
maximum frequency of any objective primary family is at most max_same_objective_primary
maximum lifestyle low_run is at most max_low_decision_run
manual partial and strong each win at least one cell and new_decisions increases by tier
every terminal resource stock is at most max_terminal_stock
every switching recovery is non-null and at most max_switch_recovery
three monotonic stages, at least three alternatives per stage, zero unknown resource requirements
at least min_persona_primary_families unique primary families across policy classes
every seeded check has observed classification equal to its expected classification
